news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 4 experienced directors. 2 highly experienced directors. Non-Executive & Non-Independent Director Mehul Shah was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2022. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.04 (vs ₹0.09 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.04 (down from ₹0.09 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹59.1m (down 3.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹433.0k (down 49% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.7% (down from 1.4% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 1% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 8% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
